name: OSPYR·2 SALES & PROPOSAL BRAIN — 26 sub-automations: pitch → proposal → contract → onboard

parameters.content:
# 📜 O2 · SALES & PROPOSAL BRAIN (26 sub-automations)
**PITCH (7):** ① `#pitch niche/name` on Telegram → AI 1-page pitch ② pricing pulled from your Service Catalogue tab ③ per-niche bundle suggestion ④ objection-handling cheat sheet ⑤ competitor-aware angle ⑥ ROI mini-math ⑦ voice pitch via ElevenLabs (send as audio).
**PROPOSAL (7):** ⑧ `#proposal name/scope/budget` → full proposal text ⑨ scope+timeline+deliverables table ⑩ 3-tier pricing (good/better/best) ⑪ terms block ⑫ saved to Proposals tab ⑬ Google Doc copy note ⑭ one-tap send link.
**CONTRACT & CLOSE (6):** ⑮ `#contract` → service agreement draft ⑯ e-sign chase D+2/D+5 ⑰ deal Won → auto-onboard kickoff ⑱ deal Lost → AI loss-reason log ⑲ win announcement ⑳ referral ask after Won.
**ONBOARD (6):** ㉑ welcome pack message ㉒ client folder checklist ㉓ access-request list (Meta/GBP/site) ㉔ kickoff call booking ㉕ first-30-days plan generated ㉖ handoff to Delivery Brain (O3 webhook).

**KEYS:** GEMINI_API_KEY · ELEVENLABS_API_KEY+VOICE_ID · TG_OSPYR_CHAT · OSPYR_SHEET_ID (tabs: Catalogue[Service,Price], Proposals, Deals) · N8N_BASE_URL.
**FIX:** pricing wrong → Catalogue tab is the source of truth; voice fails → voice ID must be multilingual v2.

If pitch → 1-page pitch: hook, 3 pains for that niche, our fix, bundle suggestion with real prices, ROI mini-math, 3 objection answers, CTA.
If proposal → full proposal: summary, scope table (deliverable|timeline|owner), 3-tier pricing (good/better/best with real prices), terms (50% advance, 30-day cycles), next steps.
If contract → simple service agreement draft (scope, fees, term, IP, confidentiality, termination, jurisdiction Mysore).
If won → onboarding kickoff: welcome message + access checklist (Meta/GBP/site/analytics) + first-30-days plan.
If lost → 3 likely loss reasons + one win-back line." }] }] }
